confidence.rationale: The live restaurant-linked Toast menu confirms the restaurant identity and exposes the relevant item names and descriptions. Most positive allergen signals are directly supported by those disclosures, but several generated claims rely only on culinary-name inference and are not established by the published text. Terra therefore reached the correct outcome but materially overstated the scope.

confirmedFindings: A limited allergen-source discrepancy exists: claims such as wheat/gluten for wonton soups; wheat/gluten/egg for mousse cakes; and milk/wheat/gluten/egg for cheesecake are not established by the corresponding Toast names or descriptions.
The Toast menu publishes a gluten-free category but no comprehensive allergen matrix, complete ingredient lists, allergen legend, or cross-contact policy.
Restaurant identity is verified as Asian Grill at 6228 Rolling Rd # A, Springfield, VA 22152, phone (703) 569-4800.
rejectedFindings: Rejected Terra's characterization that all 99 positive allergen assertions are unsupported. The Toast source directly discloses fish, shrimp, scallops, crab, cashews, sesame seeds, egg, and peanut sauce in many item names or restaurant-authored descriptions; those positive signals do not require a complete allergen matrix.
Rejected the proposed blanket downgrade of all positive claims to unavailable. Any repair should distinguish direct restaurant disclosures from unsupported culinary-term inference.
Terra's stated count of 99 affected official-ingredients items does not align with the frozen generated restaurant metadata, which reports 93 officially supported items and 96 disclosure signals.

additionalEvidence.summary: Live Toast menu confirms identity and provides direct disclosures including fish, shrimp, scallops, cashews, sesame seeds, egg, and peanut dipping sauce, while also showing that no comprehensive allergen matrix or cross-contact statement is published.

Toast item detail confirms the same restaurant and shows configurable ingredient options and a GLUTEN FREE request option, but it does not function as an item-level allergen declaration or complete ingredient disclosure.

summary: Uphold discrepancy_found, but narrow the finding substantially. Direct ingredient/allergen words in the restaurant-linked Toast names and descriptions support most existing positive claims. The actual defect is the smaller subset of claims inferred from culinary terms without an explicit restaurant disclosure, together with the absence of cross-contact information and complete negative-claim coverage.
coordinatorActions: Return for a scoped parser/source review that preserves allergens directly disclosed in restaurant-authored names or descriptions.
Identify and downgrade only claims derived from unsupported culinary-name inference, especially cakes and wonton dishes, unless stronger restaurant-issued evidence is found.
Do not treat the gluten-free category or item customization controls as a complete allergen matrix or cross-contact guarantee.
Recalculate affected-item and disclosure counts before ingesting the adjudication.
